findings.summary: The formation date of December 11, 2023 — 19 days post-OpenAI reinstatement and 9 days after the Real Deal portfolio exposé — is consistent with formation of new acquisition vehicles with more opaque naming to avoid press identification
findings.detail: The Real Deal published 'OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's $85 Million Real Estate Splurge' on December 2, 2023, identifying several Altman LLCs by linking them through Jennifer Serralta. Nine days later (Dec 11), Heron and Meramec were filed. Altman's earlier confirmed entities used transparent names (950 Lombard, Green Valley Ranch Napa, SAM ALTMAN QUALIFIED OPPORTUNITY FUND). Heron and Meramec are more opaque, potentially reflecting increased awareness of media scrutiny.
